name: text2video-energy-benchmark
description: A benchmark that measures energy consumption and compute/resource costs of text-to-video generation models across prompts and model sizes. It aims to quantify environmental and efficiency trade-offs (energy use, estimated CO2, runtime) for text->video pipelines rather than perceptual quality alone.
evaluation_method: energy_consumption (Joules per sample) / estimated CO2 and runtime (efficiency metrics)
reputation: A specialized benchmark from an energy/efficiency advocacy group; growing interest among researchers studying model efficiency but not widely adopted for mainstream model comparisons.
